admission.justification: Enforces KNO-R13@v1 AC-2 uniform wire schema and catalog-driven language resolution across all seven code-serving routes without duplicating hardcoded extension maps.

applicability: All seven code-serving backend surfaces: File Viewer (/api/files/read), Change-Set Viewer (/api/changeset/* via diff_side), Knowledge Reader (truth.code_view), Notes Reader (/api/notes/read), Review Source Content (ReviewSourceSide / review_source_content), Review Expression Cards (review_tree_entries._excerpt), and Role Report Viewer (cli/role_report._read_report_file).
conditions: serving/scope.py language_for delegates directly to resolve_display_language with no hardcoded _LANG_BY_EXT map.
Textual payloads attach strict immutable SyntaxHighlights ({v, lang, tokens, spans}) when available and null when unavailable, oversized, or degraded.
Binary and media payloads on files, diff_side, and notes emit explicit highlights: null; ReviewSourceSide enforces structurally that only present textual sides may carry highlights.
exclusions: Knowledge Reader binary state omits the optional highlights key rather than serializing explicit null (media state emits explicit null; the TypeScript highlights?: SyntaxHighlights | null contract accepts both).
Client-side rendering of received highlights (covered by AC-3).

evidence: mcp/tests/test_unified_tree_sitter_highlights.py::LiveGrammarHighlightTests::{test_all_serving_surfaces_carry_contract_valid_highlights,test_surface_3_knowledge_reader_code_route_contract} (152 passed, 235 subtests passed on clean-copy tree 8e2b8ed2889265fea2a81be8c3fb8e889a194990)

statement: All seven code-serving surfaces resolve display language from the language catalog (with no hardcoded _LANG_BY_EXT table) and attach compact SyntaxHighlights on textual payloads while emitting highlights: null on binary, media, oversized, or unavailable payloads.
title: All seven code surfaces resolve catalog languages and attach SyntaxHighlights
